_comment: The author's presets of settings (services/Presets, Settings → Presets, `angelos preset`).
They share one list of settings: every key any of them names. A preset puts each key of that
list to its own value ("set") or, when it doesn't name it, to its default — so the presets
replace each other cleanly, and nothing outside the list is ever touched. Keys are
"section.key" of config/SettingsSchema.qml; never the shell's bookkeeping (Config.notUndoable:
the game being on is the user's own switch, not a preset's). "points": what it does, in words.

presets.hintRu: angelOS из коробки: всё движется, светится и разговаривает
presets.hintEn: angelOS out of the box: everything moves, glows and talks
pointsEn: the angel jokes and gives tips
cobwebs, sparkles, lyrics on the bar

presets.hintRu: то же самое, но без вспышек, тряски и внезапного
presets.hintEn: the same, without flashes, shaking and surprises
pointsRu: движение «спокойное»: без вспышек и тряски экрана
ангел без шуток, буквы не дёргаются
обои живые, но без внезапных событий

the angel without jokes, her letters keep still
